newsitem.title: USA: Healtheon names Mike Long president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Healtheon names Mike Long president/CEO.

text.p: Healtheon Corp, a private company that offers health and benefits services over the Internet, said Monday it named Mike Long president and chief executive.
He succeeds David Schnell, co-founder and acting president and chief executive.

Most recently, Long held the same positions at CSC Continuum, a unit of Computer Sciences Corp that supplies application software, consulting and outsourcing services to insurance and banking companies.
Jim Clark, the founder of Netscape Communications Corp and Silicon Graphics Inc, is the chairman and founder of Healtheon.

Healtheon also said in its press release that it signed a deal with the National Account Service Company Llc (NASCO). NASCO, a consortium of Blue Cross and Blue Shield health plans, will offer Healtheon's benefits administration service to its 47 member health plans, the company said.
